resources.string: Let Better Lyrics see what\'s playing

Better Lyrics reads the media session your music app publishes — track, artist, album, duration and the live playhead — so it can line lyrics up with the song. Android puts that behind “notification access”.\n\nNothing is uploaded except the track title and artist, and only to look up lyrics.
Start a song in Spotify (or any player) and it will show up here.
